title: Capture provenance labels
responsibility: Explains capture origin and acceptance separately from the revision a verification attempt targeted.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.record
inputs.description: Record supplying validity, outcome and target revision.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario supplying tested revision, inheritance and original record.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.capture
inputs.description: Capture supplying status, source build and optional provenance.

inputs.name: scenarioOrigin.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario whose result origin should be summarized.

outputs.name: captureProvenance
outputs.description: Standing, label, facts and full-revision note. Invalid records take precedence over failed captures; otherwise captures are rejected, inherited or fresh. Rejection labels distinguish a different recorded build from a required build stamp that is missing.

outputs.name: scenarioOrigin
outputs.description: Inherited origin, tested revision for a passed scenario, or failed-attempt revision plus distinct other capture revisions when present.
